record.question: Which of the following is not correct about Act East Policy?
options: India's Act East Policy was unveiled by the Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi at 12th ASEAN-India Summit in 2014 held in Myanmar.
Act East Policy is the predecessor of Look East Policy.
The Act East Policy was originally conceived as an economic initiative.
The objective of 'Act East Policy' is to promote economic cooperation, cultural ties and development strategic relationship with countries in the Asia-Pacific region.
